desc: Derive the monotonic-stack invariant and formulas for updating the required increment cost when extending the window leftward.
Design the deletion operation when shrinking the window from the right, ensuring stack groups and accumulated cost remain correct.
Prove that the sliding-window validity condition is monotonic and determine the exact number of valid subarrays contributed at each step.
Implement the algorithm in the required `Solution.countNonDecreasingSubarrays` Python format, handling large values and answer bounds safely.
Run the provided examples and targeted edge-case tests, including sorted, decreasing, singleton, repeated, and large-value arrays.
